Project title: AgriSense: IoT Smart Agriculture Soil & Crop Monitoring System
Project type: PFE / Master Thesis
Domain: IoT & Precision Agriculture
Problem statement: Traditional farming suffers from inefficient water usage, delayed pest detection, and lack of real-time soil analytics, leading to reduced crop yields and high resource wastage.
Objective: Develop an end-to-end IoT platform collecting real-time soil moisture, temperature, and drone imagery to provide predictive irrigation and fertilizer recommendations.
Solution type: Embedded Systems, Web Application, Mobile Application, Cloud Backend
Technologies: ESP32, LoRaWAN, MQTT, Node.js, Express, React, React Native, InfluxDB, PostgreSQL, Docker
Methodology: Scrum
Target users: Farm Managers, Field Workers
Actors: Farm Manager: Configures sensor thresholds, views analytics, and receives automated alerts.; Field Worker: Performs manual sensor maintenance and executes task orders via mobile app.; System Admin: Manages tenant accounts, device provisioning, and network gateways.
Existing solutions: FarmLogs: Provides field mapping and rain tracking.; CropX: Soil sensor analytics.
Functional requirements: Real-time Telemetry Ingestion: Ingest sensor telemetry via MQTT/LoRaWAN gateway at 60s intervals.; Automated Irrigation Scheduling: Compute optimal watering windows based on soil moisture and weather forecasts.; Alerts & Notifications: Trigger SMS/Push notifications when critical soil threshold anomalies occur.; Drone Imagery Analysis: Upload and display normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) heatmaps.
Non-functional requirements: Low Power Consumption: Sensor nodes must run on battery/solar for 12+ months.; Data Latency: Telemetry to dashboard ingestion delay must not exceed 2 seconds.
Product backlog user stories: Telemetry: Implement LoRaWAN packet parser and MQTT broker client Mosquitto + Node.js; Dashboard: Build time-series interactive chart view for soil metrics Chart.js / InfluxDB; Mobile: Create offline-first mobile inspection forms for field workers React Native

Objective: Build an event-driven payment processing engine with sub-100ms machine learning fraud evaluation and PCI-DSS compliant card vaulting.
